info.title: OneWarehouse Public API (POS)
info.description:
Inter-branch transfer (with serial numbers) API consumed by POS. Human-readable contract: `docs/pos-integration/transfer-sn-integration.md`.

**Concurrency & idempotency (§8).** Send `opKey` on every write that requires it (retries are safe). Echo `version` from `GET /transfers/{id}` as `expectedVersion`; a stale value → 409 `transfer_version_conflict`. A 409 `transfer_concurrency` means: keep the same `opKey` and retry.

**Errors (§9).** Every 4xx/5xx is `{code, params?, message, statusCode}`; scans return `{code:"scan_rejected", problems[], statusCode:422}`.

| code | params | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `serial_unknown` | serialNo | serial not in stock / not found |
| `serial_wrong_warehouse` | serialNo, foundWarehouseId, expectedWarehouseId | serial is at another branch |
| `serial_wrong_sku` | serialNo, foundSku, expectedSku | serial belongs to a different SKU |
| `serial_not_in_stock` | serialNo, status | serial not in a shippable state |
| `serial_duplicate` | serialNo | scanned twice |
| `serial_not_shipped` | serialNo | (scan-in) was not shipped on this transfer |
| `sku_not_on_order` | sku | scanned SKU isn't on this transfer |
| `qty_mismatch` | sku, scanned, needed | count ≠ line qty |
| `line_kind_unknown` | sku | scan-out: catalog does not say if the SKU is serialized — classify it first |
| `line_kind_mismatch` | sku | serials sent for a qty-only SKU, or a qty for a serialized SKU |
| `short_reason_required` | sku, scanned, needed | qty line shipped short without a `shortReason` |
| `qty_exceeds_shipped` | sku, received, shipped | (scan-in) received would exceed what shipped |
| `line_written_off` | sku | (scan-in) the line was already written off by close-short |
| `transfer_not_editable` | transferId, status | PATCH `lines` outside `draft` — open a new transfer |
| `transfer_not_cancellable` | status, step | cancel after the stock may have shipped — use close-short |
| `transfer_version_conflict` | currentVersion | someone else changed it — reload (§8) |
| `transfer_wrong_status` | status, needed | action not allowed in current status |
| `step_not_allowed` | step, allowed | step cannot be driven through /steps/:step |
| `transfer_multi_line_unsupported` | lineCount | JST books one SKU line per transfer (create 1-line transfers) |
| `jst_sync_failed` | phase | JST push failed — retry safe via same opKey |

**Auth.** Service-to-service via Central Login (see `securitySchemes`): send `X-Service-Token` and `X-On-Behalf-Of-Sub` (the numeric Central Login `sub` of the branch user) on every call. The guard returns 401 without a valid service token or a numeric sub, 403 when the user has no active access or lacks the required capability, and 503 (fail closed) when the authorization service is unavailable. Enforcement is switched on per deployment (`CENTRAL_LOGIN_ENABLED`).

**Events.** See `webhooks` (Pub/Sub topics): `transfer.created|shipped|inbound|closed|voided`. Until you subscribe, poll `GET /transfers?status=active`.

servers.description: Base path (stable, versioned). Unversioned routes are internal.

get.description: Full list of warehouses as a flat array (no paging at current cardinality), ordered by `warehouse_id`. OneWarehouse is the source of truth for this dimension; read-only federated consumers (MDM) join on `warehouse_id`. Also the reconciliation fallback for the `warehouse.upserted` event. Auth: `X-Service-Token` + `X-On-Behalf-Of-Sub`, and the caller needs the inventory-read capability (same as the other `/v1` reads).

403.description: The user has no active access or lacks the inventory-read capability.

get.summary: Product search (picker) with on-hand per warehouse — or, without `q`, catalog list
get.description:
**List mode — no `q` parameter (catalog enumeration for POS bootstrap).** Returns `{items, next_cursor, has_more}`: a keyset page (sku ascending) of the LOCAL synced products index (`sync:products`), never a live JST call per SKU. This split is the correct design, not a compromise: the list is served from the index, so it reflects the LAST SYNC and may lag the sync interval, and it never fans N live calls out at JST (rate limits); point lookups by exact SKU (`?q=<sku>`) stay live JST. Items use the same projection as search; the price and `is_combined` fields are `null` in list mode (the index does not hold them) — read them via `?q=<sku>`. Page with `limit` (default 50, max 200) and the opaque `cursor` taken from `next_cursor` (`null` + `has_more:false` on the last page); a malformed cursor → 400 `bad_cursor`. `warehouseId`/`category`/`brand` are optional filters. An empty index returns `{items:[],next_cursor:null,has_more:false}` (nothing is fabricated).

**Search mode — `q` present (even empty), unchanged, bare array.** JST-faithful display data. When `POS_READS_FROM_JST` is on, `name`, `short_name`, `barcode`, `category`, `brand`, `image_url` (JST `GetItemSkus`) and `availableQty` (JST `GetWarehouseSkuInventorys`) are JST values VERBATIM (Thai/Chinese script preserved; an empty JST string stays `""`), served from a short-TTL stale-while-revalidate cache (`POS_CACHE_TTL_PRODUCTS_MS` 60s, `POS_CACHE_TTL_STOCK_MS` 30s, `POS_CACHE_STALE_MS` 5min). The local catalog is only the search index (JST cannot search by name); an exact-SKU `q` that is not indexed is looked up in JST directly. `serial_tracking` is not exposed by JST `GetItemSkus` and stays classified locally. JST unreachable with nothing cached → 502.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches sku/barcode/name/brand.

parameters.name: warehouseId
parameters.description: Warehouse whose `availableQty` to return.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Search mode (`q` present): max 50, default 20. List mode (no `q`): max 200, default 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: List mode only: opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: Search mode: matches (array). List mode: one page of the synced index.

get.description: BOM is pending: the JST open API exposes no combo-component query (use `is_combined` on `/products` to know a SKU is a bundle). Returns **501** `{sku, available:false, reason}` unless `JST_COMBO_ENDPOINT` names a working JST method, in which case it serves the verbatim rows (short-TTL cached). Needs `POS_READS_FROM_JST` (else 503). 404 `combo_unknown` when the configured method has no combo for the SKU.

501.description: BOM not available (open-API limitation; pending internal-API integration).

get.summary: On-hand of one SKU at one warehouse
get.description: Pass `sku` AND `warehouseId` for a single `{sku,warehouseId,qty}`; or `warehouseId` AND `skus` (comma-separated, ≤50) for an array of them. With `POS_READS_FROM_JST` on, `qty` is JST current on-hand for that warehouse (short-TTL cached, `POS_CACHE_TTL_STOCK_MS` default 30s), not the OneWarehouse ledger. A lone `warehouseId` is ignored and ALL ledger stock is returned (prefer /products). Only `sellable` stock counts as available: damaged / return / inbound units are excluded (`?stockType=damaged|return|inbound|all` on the list form shows the other buckets).

parameters.name: skus
parameters.description: Comma-separated SKUs (≤50), with `warehouseId`.

parameters.name: warehouseId
parameters.description: Warehouse (only effective together with `sku` or `skus`).

get.summary: Sales of a branch, newest first

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: orderTime ≥ (ISO-8601 with offset).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: orderTime < (ISO-8601 with offset).

post.description: Idempotent on `opKey`: a retry with the same body returns the first sale (**200**, not 201); the same `opKey` with a different body → 409 `sale_op_key_conflict`. Hard errors (422): totals ≠ payments, duplicate SN in the bill, more SNs than qty, SNs on a non-serial SKU, SN already on another live sale, unknown branch. A serialized line short of SNs, or an SN our ledger does not know at the branch warehouse, is ACCEPTED as `sn_pending` (no stock cut; fix with PATCH). With `JST_SALE_WRITE` off the sale stays `submitted`. Human-readable contract: `docs/pos-integration/sale-integration.md`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sale id (uuid) as returned by POST /sales.

patch.summary: Fix an SN / edit a sale
patch.description: Allowed only while `submitted` | `sn_pending` | `failed`, **within 7 days of `orderTime`** (409 `sale_edit_locked` after), and before JST accepted the bill. `lines` replaces all lines. Idempotent on `opKey`; stale `expectedVersion` → 409 `sale_version_conflict`. Re-validates, and (flag on) re-drives JST.

parameters.description: Sale id (uuid).

patch.description: Uses `expectedVersion` only — `opKey` is NOT accepted here. `lines` (add / remove / qty; replaces the whole list) is accepted ONLY in `draft`; in any other status → 409 `transfer_not_editable` (open a new transfer). `lineNotes` stay editable until closed.

post.description: A warehouse row in the master changed (inserted, or its name changed) — emitted in the same DB transaction as the change (transactional outbox). Payload = the `Warehouse` row + `schemaVersion` + `occurredAt`. At-least-once; dedupe on envelope `id`. A deactivation is carried by `status` on the next `warehouse.upserted`.

ApiError.description: Envelope of every handled 4xx/5xx. Map `code` to your own localized string.

ScanRejected.description: Scan list form (§9): every violation, structured.

statusReason.description: Why sn_pending / failed — JST's reason verbatim when JST said it.

jstSync.description: Latest JST / ledger attempt (null if none).

sale_price.description: JST `salePrice`, verbatim (0 stays 0). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

member_price.description: JST `memberPrice`, verbatim (0 stays 0). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

wholesale_price.description: JST `wholesalePrice`, verbatim (0 stays 0). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

tag_price.description: JST `nameplatePrice` (tag price), verbatim (0 stays 0). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

cost_price.description: JST `costPrice`, verbatim (0 stays 0). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

is_combined.description: JST `isCombined` — this SKU is a combo set (BOM via `GET /products/{sku}/components`). Present only with `POS_READS_FROM_JST`; `null` = JST omitted it.

Warehouse.description: Warehouse master row (flat keys). Pass-through of what JST carries — language shape is NOT validated here (consumers coerce/validate on ingest).

warehouse_id.description: STABLE id and the join key to federate on. In Phase 1 this is the JST warehouse id (does not churn).

code.description: Warehouse code. MAY equal `warehouse_id` (day one it does — JST GetWarehouses carries no separate code).

name_th.description: Nullable. Currently always null (JST carries a single name).

name_en.description: Always present (non-null). Faithful passthrough — no script detection or coercion on our side. Day one this is JST's single warehouse name, so it MAY BE NON-LATIN (e.g. Thai script); consumers own naming semantics on ingest.

name_zh.description: Nullable; null is normal — do not promise zh downstream until OneWarehouse owns the master. Currently always null.

type.description: Coarse. Currently always `branch` (JST does not distinguish).

status.description: Currently always `active` (a warehouse is present while JST lists it).

updated_at.description: Last change OneWarehouse OBSERVED (insert or a name change in our read model) — NOT necessarily when it was edited in JST. A re-sync that changes nothing does not move it. For rows that pre-date migration 0011 it is the migration time.

TransferAggregate.description: Raw `Transfer` aggregate returned by writes (NOT the enriched TransferView — re-GET /transfers/{id} for that).

purpose.description: What the stock is for (stores bill demo / display separately). Default `stock`.

TransferView.description: §6 — the scan-screen shape. No `direction` here: compute it from `fromWarehouseId`/`toWarehouseId`.

purpose.description: What the stock is for (stores bill demo / display separately). Default `stock`.

quantities.description: Shipped qty of the qty-only (non-serialized) lines.

QtyLine.description: A qty-only line: shipped / received / still open (a short receipt stays open until close-short).

open.description: false once the transfer is closed.

WarehouseEventEnvelope.description: Pub/Sub message body for `warehouse.upserted`. At-least-once: dedupe on `id`. `GET /warehouses` is the reconciliation fallback.

id.description: Outbox row uuid — stable dedupe key.

EventEnvelope.description: Pub/Sub message body. At-least-once delivery, ordering NOT guaranteed across transfers: dedupe on `id`, drop stale events using `data.version`.

id.description: Outbox row uuid — stable dedupe key.

serviceToken.name: X-Service-Token
serviceToken.description: Shared service token issued to the POS client (server env `SERVICE_TOKEN`); compared in constant time. Missing/invalid → 401.

adminBearer.description: Admin credential (`Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_API_TOKEN>`) required by admin-only operations such as close-short. Fails closed (403) when the server has no admin token configured.

onBehalfOf.name: X-On-Behalf-Of-Sub
onBehalfOf.description: Numeric Central Login `sub` of the branch user the call is made for, so one login + shared permissions flow through. Missing or non-numeric → 401.
